Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the main change: authenticating the identity before deploy plan verification in the Terraform component. The changeset adds SetupTerraformAuth to OperationServices and calls it in resolveVerificationContext before stack processing, which matches the title. The title uses the conventional 'fix(terraform):' prefix and is specific enough for a teammate scanning history.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** [`#3784`] The reviewed diff changes `resolveVerificationContext` in `pkg/component/terraform/verify_plan.go`. Before `ProcessStacks` runs, the code now calls `s.host.SetupTerraformAuth(&atmosConfig, &authInfo)`. It passes the resulting auth manager to `ProcessStacks` in place of nil. A failed login returns `failed to authenticate for plan verification: %w`, so verification stops. This addresses the reported cause: stacks were processed with YAML functions on and no credentials. `!secret` and `!terraform.state` run in the same processing step, so both are covered. `SetupTerraformAuth` delegates to `SetupComponentAuthForCLI` in `internal/exec/terraform.go`, which matches the bulk path's credential handling. Two new tests in `pkg/component/terraform/verify_plan_auth_test.go` check auth-before-processing order and auth error propagation. The fresh plan step was not changed in this diff. It runs through the existing execution path, which authenticates on its own. This is a reasoned inference, not an end-to-end check. Real AWS KMS and GitHub OIDC runs were not performed, as the PR states.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** All changed areas connect to the issue. `verify_plan.go` holds the fix. `provider.go` adds `SetupTerraformAuth` to `OperationServices`, which the fix needs. `internal/exec/terraform.go` implements that method by reusing the existing component auth setup. `mock_runtime_test.go` adds the generated mock for the new interface method. `verify_plan_auth_test.go` adds tests for the fix. No unrelated changes were found in the reviewed evidence.
